title: Compact automatic test completion notifications without losing actionable evidence
outcome: Reduce repeated routine test output entering coordinator context while keeping failure diagnostics, warnings, evidence identity and full results directly recoverable.
acceptance: Automatic PASS, FAIL, interrupted and unknown summaries retain run identity, actual outcome and exit status, input-verification information or its exact locator, warnings, actionable failure diagnostics, explicit truncation and results/log locators; unrun stages are never presented as passed.

Collapse redundant successful-stage/preflight listings and unchanged explanatory boilerplate in automatic notifications; full stage-by-stage results remain available on demand, and notification retries reuse the frozen message and idempotency identity without rerunning tests.

Representative before/after fixtures cover success, failure with unrun stages, warnings, exceptions, interruption and truncation, demonstrating smaller automatic messages while preserving required evidence; compare a real retained failure notification and the corrected output without claiming measured provider-token savings.

completion.summary: Compact automatic test completion notifications preserve run outcome, input boundary caveats, warnings and actionable diagnostics while grouping clean successes; detailed CLI and immutable retry bodies remain available. Representative fixtures and exact full gate pass; required independent pair has Notes only; independent acceptance3/3 passed. Historical failure output27.2%smaller and live delivered completion26.2%smaller by UTF-8bytes, no provider-token claim. Landed/pushed/installed clean release with backup, all4live stores ready, no running-session restart needed.
